corrections.reason: The second Fidel in እስአል is clearly 6th-order ስ (with the left horizontal bend), which is the standard Ge'ez 1st-person singular subjunctive ('let me ask leave / bid farewell').
The first Fidel of the noun is 7th-order ቆ (ቆናማተ, 'wallet/scrip' in Luke 10:4), clearly showing the top loop rather than a right-side 2nd-order tick.

corrections.visual_confusable_pair: ወኅበ ቦጻእክሙ ቤት -> ወኀበ በጻሕክሙ ቤተ
corrections.reason: Canonical Ge'ez of Luke 10:5 ('And into whatsoever house ye enter/arrive') and the printed glyphs clearly read ወኀበ (1st-order ኀ) በጻሕክሙ (from በጽሐ, with 1st-order በ and 6th-order ሕ, not ቦጻእክሙ) ቤተ (accusative 1st-order ተ).
